title: TFT overview, screening and binding-protein effects
sec: TFT overview, screening and binding-protein effects · p902
guide: Anchor the universal neonatal screen, the negative recommendation for routine community screening, and the binding-protein model. Distinguish true thyroid disease from TBG- and albumin-driven changes in total hormone so treatment is not triggered by estrogens, pregnancy, steroids or liver disease.

title: Pituitary feedback, sick-euthyroid and resistance states
sec: Pituitary feedback, sick-euthyroid and resistance states · p903
guide: Layer pituitary feedback on top of the binding-protein model. Connect low T3 / high rT3 to non-thyroidal illness and learn why RTH breaks the simple suppress-TSH-with-excess-hormone rule.

title: TFT patterns: thyrotoxicosis, T3-toxicosis, sick-euthyroid, thyroglobulin
sec: TFT patterns: thyrotoxicosis, T3-toxicosis, sick-euthyroid, thyroglobulin · p904
guide: Read the page's totals vs. frees table as a flowchart. Tie thyroglobulin behaviour to factitious versus endogenous thyrotoxicosis so thyroiditis, toxic nodules and surreptitious intake can be separated biochemically.
